quests.name: A Parcel for the Magic Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Renudale to the magic shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the magic shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the banker.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Staff Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the staff shop keeper of Renudale and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the staff shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The general store keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Renudale Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Renudale Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Renudale Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Spiders
quests.summary: The sword shop keeper wants the spider near Renudale thinned out.
intro: The spider beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 14 of them close to Renudale and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Yew Logs
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper of Renudale has run out of yew logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 22 yew logs and nobody in Renudale has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Realtor
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Renudale to the realtor.
intro: This should have gone to the realtor days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the magic shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Banker
quests.summary: Call on the banker of Renudale and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the banker and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The clothes shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Renudale Sewers (Food Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Climb down into Renudale Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Renudale Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Renudale and bring back yew logs.
intro: The wilds around Renudale need a firm hand. Start with 14 spider outside the walls, then 22 giant spider down in Renudale Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 22 yew logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Renudale for the general store keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the magic shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The general store keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the magic shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.

quests.name: Sweeping the Renudale Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Renudale Sewers and tell the archery shop keeper.
intro: Renudale Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 22 of them, then let the archery shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Renudale owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Renudale Sewers is clearer than it was. 22 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Narustead
quests.summary: Gather coal for the sword shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Narustead.
intro: I have an order from Narustead and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 28 coal, then take the packed shipment to the sword shop keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the sword shop keeper in Renudale.
From Renudale? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Renudale and bring back willow logs.
intro: The wilds around Renudale need a firm hand. Start with 14 spider outside the walls, then 22 zombie down in Renudale Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 28 willow logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council (Magic Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Gather support around Renudale for the magic shop keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the food shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The magic shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the armour shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the food shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Renudale Sewers (Clothes Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Renudale Sewers and tell the general store keeper.
intro: Renudale Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 22 of them, then let the general store keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Renudale owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Renudale Sewers is clearer than it was. 22 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Narustead (Food Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Gather raw lobster for the food shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Narustead.
intro: I have an order from Narustead and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 22 raw lobster, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the food shop keeper in Renudale.
From Renudale? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Renudale
quests.summary: Find what rules Renudale Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Ooze Mother.
intro: Something rules Renudale Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the realtor what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Renudale is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Ooze Mother.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Ooze Mother is dead. Renudale Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Fallen Warden
quests.summary: March on Ashen Redoubt, break its creatures and bring down The Fallen Warden.
intro: Ashen Redoubt has stood against Renudale for too long. The Fallen Warden sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the armour shop keeper, fight your way through 34 skeleton and end The Fallen Warden.
Bring 17 bones back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Ashen Redoubt?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Fallen Warden rules it now.
player: Word from Renudale: The Fallen Warden is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Renudale Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Renudale and Narustead.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Narustead. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 34 zombie near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the barber underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the banker in Renudale.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Narustead is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Renudale has not had news this good in years.
